newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian has photo of men at Versace home - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian has photo of men at Versace home - report.

text.p: A Brazilian woman took a photo of two men at the gates of slain fashion designer Gianni Versace's Miami mansion and then heard screams the day before his murder, Brazil's TV Globo reported on Wednesday.
Globo News said the woman, who was not identified, heard the screams coming from inside Versace's Miami Beach mansion on Monday after she had photographed the two men at the entrance.

In the photo shown on TV Globo, a man wearing sunglasses, a white T-shirt and black pants walks away from the mansion, while the other, wearing white shorts and a white T-Shirt, is standing at the gates waiting to go in carrying a black bag.
The woman said she heard the screams coming from the house after the man in white had gone in, Globo News said.
The photo shows the face of the man with sunglasses who was walking away from the gates, but the other man had his back turned to the camera.
Versace was shot twice in the head at close range by a lone gunman on the steps of his Ocean Drive home on Tuesday morning.
Miami police are searching for an alleged serial killer and homosexual prostitute, Andrew Cunanan, who is the prime suspect in the murder case.
Cunanan is wanted for four previous murders, including that of his former male lover, allegedly committed during a two-week, cross-country killing spree that began in April in Minneapolis.
